programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

Prellungen, Knochenbrüche und Verbrennungen sind typische Unfallfolgen in dem Beruf. In einem Ofen werden die Eisen für die Hufe auf 1100 Grad erhitzt und dann auf dem Amboss in die richtige Form geschlagen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Jürgen Böhme und Andreas Arnold müssen sich beeilen. Ein Mobilfunkmast ist ausgefallen. Tausende Menschen müssen auf Internet und Telefon verzichten. Im schlimmsten Fall können in dem Gebiet auch keine Notrufe abgesetzt werden. Die Servicetechniker gehen auf Fehlersuche und klettern dafür den 35 Meter hohen Funkmast hoch. Auf sie muss Verlass sei – egal bei welchem Wetter.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In Altaussee in der Steiermark arbeiten 57 Menschen im Salzbergwerk und produzieren 450.000 Tonnen Natursalz im Jahr. Im sogenannten Trockenabbau kommen nur wenige Maschinen zum Einsatz, dafür ist umso mehr Muskelkraft gefragt. Tageslicht bekommen die Bergarbeiter dabei nicht zu sehen – und sie sind nicht die Einzigen, die in völliger Dunkelheit arbeiten.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In einer Hamburger Werft liegt eine Hafenfähre zur Modernisierung. Das Schiff wurde dafür komplett entkernt. Ein halbes Jahr soll die Fähre in der Werft bleiben, dann soll sie wieder auf die Elbe. Schiffsbauer Melvin Ommer und Torben Groth bauen die generalüberholte Antriebsmaschine wieder ein. Gar nicht so einfach, denn das riesige Bauteil wiegt 1,5 Tonnen, und der Maschinenraum ist eng.

programme.title: Destination Pluto

New Horizons fliegt immer weiter und erforscht nun den Kuipergürtel und die Heliosphäre. Es ist eine Welt, die wir bis jetzt noch nie gesehen haben.

While they're in prison, the Chinese Triad kills a gang member. As revenge looms, aging gangster Bernie (David Bowie) struggles to maintain peace.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Feeling ignored on Student Council, Emma finds a way to get her voice heard when she takes up a new cause - ganging up with the cool kids to keep Terri’s abusive ex-boyfriend Rick, out of Degrassi.

programme.desc: Things are going great for Sean and Ellie, Degrassi’s most unlikely couple—so well that Sean asks Ellie to move in. Despite their closeness, Ellie hesitates and Sean doesn’t understand why.

programme.desc: In her quest to repay Spinner for damage to his car, Alpha Paige has gone all beta. programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Craig’s back with Ashley and he’s determined not to screw it up this time.

programme.desc: Lorsque son mari est hospitalisé à la suite d'un accident de voiture, Karen, ambulancière, décide de louer leur chambre d'amis en ligne. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.

programme.title: Le Vétérans
programme.desc: Trente ans après la chute de Saigon, le politicien Ray Watson retourne au Vietnam pour apaiser ses démons, mais il est confronté à un prisonnier de guerre qu'il a laissé derrière lui et qui le force à revivre le jour de leur capture.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le Show
programme.desc: Suit l’histoire de Tara Thompson, dont la carrière de présentatrice commence à stagner. Elle accepte de participer à une émission télévisée pour épouser son partenaire idéal , Joe, un homme qu’elle n’a jamais rencontré. Mais en secret, elle tente de le retrouver pour clarifier que le mariage n’est que pour...

programme.title: Border Run
programme.desc: Une journaliste américaine recherche son frère disparu sur fond de violence et de trafic d'êtres humains à la frontière américano-mexicaine.

programme.title: I love my mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. - April est venue pour se suicider ; Krysta et Dennis s’échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens ; Peg, l’épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse ; et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. - April demande de l’aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s’il peut l’accompagner. - Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. - Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu’ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. - Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: WELCOME BACK, MISS MARY
programme.desc: Joey Vitello, un jeune homme de vingt ans sans but, vit toujours chez ses parents au sein de sa famille italo-américaine haute en couleur. Il retrouve Mary O'Callahan, une camarade d’enfance autrefois surnommée Mary la Terrifiante . Celle qui était un vilain petit canard est devenue une beauté irrésistible, de retour dans le quartier après avoir vaincu un cancer. Lorsque Joey découvre que sa guérison est due à un miracle, leur amitié se transforme en romance, et Mary l’initie à la foi. Les nouvelles convictions de Joey bouleversent la foi de sa famille, et le chaos s’installe alors que chacun part à la recherche de son propre miracle.

programme.title: Un Endroit Sombre
programme.desc: Lorsqu’un jeune garçon disparaît dans une petite ville tranquille, Donald, un chauffeur de camion de voirie local, se lance dans une enquête précaire et obsessionnelle, jouant les détectives.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: L'Heure du Crrime
programme.desc: Guido (Filippo Timi), un ancien policier, est un vétéran malchanceux des speed-datings à Turin. Mais, à sa grande surprise, il rencontre Sonia (Ksenia Rappoport), une immigrée slovène qui travaille comme femme de chambre dans un hôtel de luxe. Entre eux, le courant passe et une romance passionnée naît. Après avoir quitté la ville pour une escapade romantique à la campagne, les choses prennent soudainement une tournure sombre. Le passé trouble de Sonia refait surface et sa réalité commence à s’effondrer. Tout change dans sa vie : des questions surgissent et les réponses n’arrivent qu’au fil de rebondissements qui tiennent le spectateur en haleine jusqu’aux dernières minutes du film. programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E02 - Blue Mind (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E10 - Way Of The Forest
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E11 - Harvesting Health
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.title: His Target
programme.desc: Keya meets Justin, an aspiring entrepreneur and thought she found the man of her dreams, but he saw her as an opportunity to make his ventures soar. The closer she gets to him, the more she falls in love, but his grip grows tighter and deadlier. A toxic relationship, soon grows into a power struggle with deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: Toxic Affair
programme.desc: A young woman abandoned by her mother and raised by her father has a miscarriage which derails her life. In an attempt to find support, she seeks out her married sister, only to find herself in a toxic affair.

programme.title: Saved By Grace
programme.desc: After being fired from her job, Grace Hightower applies for a position to work at the local church. Full of insecurity and self-doubt, her faith is tested when the church unexpectedly goes into foreclosure, forcing herself to find the courage to save it.

programme.title: Bruised
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Kayla Brown discovers that her perfect husband is not who she thought he was. Fearing for her life, she must do the unthinkable to end her nightmarish marriage, SHE MUST KILL HIM.

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it’s time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger’s luxurious home.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Maverick Movie
programme.sub-title: Knees Deep The Series: In Too Deep
programme.desc: War has begun after Mafia Kisses launches a violent ambush against GMB’s East warehouse.

programme.title: Maverick Movie
programme.sub-title: Knees Deep The Series: In Due Time
programme.desc: The war for Dallas continues as Gotti secures a partnership with Mojave, and Mafia Kisses aligns with new suppliers and hidden players that can expose the entire operation.

programme.title: Knees Deep The Series: It's Not Over...
programme.desc: New international players enter the game as the war expands beyond Dallas. With trust shattered and power shifting, one truth becomes unavoidable – this battle is far from finished.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.
